chunks: Rejoicing at what God has given them of His grace, and happy for those who are trying to overtake them but have not joined them yet, and who will have no fear or regret.

key_terms.يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ: They give glad tidings, they rejoice

ai.seo_question: What is the state of the believers in Paradise regarding fear and sorrow?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the unique spiritual state of the martyrs and righteous believers who have attained proximity to God, emphasizing their dual joy: gratitude for divine favor and glad tidings for those still striving in the world. The assurance of 'no fear and no sorrow' reflects the permanent transition from the temporal anxieties of dunya to the eternal security of akhira, a concept deeply rooted in the belief in the continuity of spiritual bonds across generations.
